name: Roblox
page_total_how: Plain GET (HTTP/1.1, browser UA) of https://careers.roblox.com/jobs: server-rendered 'Showing 262 results', and the HTML embeds all 262 Greenhouse ids. Headless Chromium (the capture and my render) fails with net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR on this CloudFront host, so there is no browser observation.
notes: absolute_url = https://careers.roblox.com/jobs/<id>?gh_jid=<id>, so the site is this board's front. The bookmark ?type=internship is only a filter; the 5 interns ([Summer 2027] SWE/PM/Product Design, [2027] PhD Applied Scientist / Data Scientist) are on the main board.
